name: style-minimal
custom_css: .screen-inner{box-shadow:var(--e2)} .btn-primary{box-shadow:0 3px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 35%,transparent)} .btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 5px 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 40%,transparent)} .opt{transition:transform var(--d-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--d-fast) var(--ease)} .opt:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
